review:
An Egyptian revenge story with two transforming orbs. The Orb of the Moon picks a random symbol type and upgrades every copy (and itself) to a higher symbol or a wild; the Orb of the Sun does it for two symbol types at once.

There's also Sacred Scripture: spell HORUS across a row with low symbols for a flat 500x. The Revenge of the Pharaoh free spins add two progress bars that unlock better features. The orbs make base spins much livelier than a typical Egyptian slot. 15,000x max.
